question: India's telecom revolution is a major outcome of liberalisation. Which regulatory authority was established in 1997 to oversee the telecom sector?
solution:
The correct answer is __**TRAI**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI)** was established in the year **1997** under the **Telecom Regulatory Authority of India Act, 1997**.
 
• TRAI was formed to regulate the **telecommunication services** in India and to promote **fair competition** in the telecom sector.
